displayName.ja: 【千両若菜】 メルメ・エルヒェム

profile.ja: 魔草使いの女。魔界において草花と共に暮らし作物を作って自給自足で暮らす一族の出身で、とある事情から故郷を離れ、ヨミハラで魔草屋を営んでいる。店は大繁盛しているわけではないが、彼女が育てる魔草は究極の一品と言われており、知る人ぞ知る隠れた名店として目の利く客の来訪が絶えない。店主の彼女はおっとりのんびりとしていて気が長く、いつもニコニコと微笑んでいて弱い女性と勘違いされがちだが、種や根さえあればあらゆる場所に魔草を生やす『萌草魔術』を用い、多種多様な魔草をハープと踊りで操って敵を絡めとる。とはいえ基本的に争い事は嫌いなため、その力を見る機会は少ない。人間界での暮らしにも馴染んでおり、季節の行事や催しにも積極的に顔を出す。新年を迎えれば晴れ着に着替え、ハープは小さな和琴に持ち替え、来店客に正月気分を味わってもらう。ただ、着慣れないためかどうにも着崩れてしまうのが悩みの様子。
profile.en: She is a woman who wields magical grass. Born into a family that lives self-sufficiently in the Demon Realm, cultivating crops and living with flowers, she left her hometown due to certain circumstances and now runs a magical grass shop in Yomihara. Although her shop isn't particularly prosperous, the magical grass she cultivates is said to be of the highest quality, and her store is a hidden gem known only to those in the know, attracting discerning customers. As the store owner, she is carefree and laid-back, often smiling, which can lead people to underestimate her. However, she can use her "Sprouting Magic" to grow magical grass anywhere, given seeds or roots, and can manipulate the diverse magical grass she has grown using her harp and dance to entangle her enemies. That being said, she generally dislikes conflict, so opportunities to see her power in action are rare. She has also adapted to life in the Human Realm and actively participates in seasonal events and festivals. When the New Year arrives, she changes into formal attire, swaps her harp for a small Japanese koto, and helps her customers get into the New Year's spirit. However, she struggles with wearing unfamiliar clothes, which often become disheveled.

text.ja: あけましておめでとうございます～。魔界の門松は、いかがでしたかぁ？　すごく元気のいい子たちですし、新年の門出にぴったりかと～
text.en: Happy New Year! How did you like the New Year's decorations at the Demon Realm's gate? They're so full of energy, perfect for the New Year's departure ceremony.

text.ja: どうでしょう、似合いますかぁ？　和服はゆったりしていて好きなんですけど、動くとすぐに着崩れちゃって……困っちゃいますねぇ
text.en: Do you think this looks good on me? I love the looseness of kimonos, but they're so prone to coming undone when I move... it's a bit of a problem.

text.ja: これはハープの代わりですよ～。お琴はハープと、また勝手が違いますけど、独特の音があって好きですね～
text.en: This is a substitute for my harp. The koto has a unique sound, different from the harp, but I really like it.

text.ja: 新年早々、休まなくていいのか……ですか？　うふふっ、新年早々だからこそ、お薬が必要な方はたくさんいらっしゃるんですよ～
text.en: Is it really okay to take a break so early in the year? Well, since it's the start of the year, there are many people who need medicine, so I suppose it's necessary.

text.ja: うーん、やっぱり新年の宴会が多いのか、酔い止めや酔い覚まし、胃腸薬なんかがよく出ますねぇ……またいっぱい、育てておかないと
text.en: I guess it's because of all the New Year's parties, but I've been selling a lot of hangover remedies and stomach medicine... I'll have to grow more.

text.ja: ちょっと遅くなっちゃいましたけど、初詣に行きませんか？　新年からお店を手伝ってくれたお礼に、屋台でごちそうしてあげちゃいます～
text.en: Would you like to go to the shrine for the New Year's visit? As a thank you for helping me with the shop, I'll treat you to some food from the stalls.

text.ja: ふふっ……いえいえ。ゆっくり歩いてくれてるんだな～って、思いまして～。私が着崩れないよう、気を遣ってくれてるんですね～
text.en: Hehe, no need to worry about me. You're just walking slowly, thinking I might trip and fall, aren't you? You're considerate of me, making sure I don't mess up my clothes.

text.ja: 新年の宴会ですし、お琴のほうが雰囲気出ますよねぇ……どうですかぁ？　みなさんにも喜んでもらえると、うれしいんですけど～
text.en: Since it's a New Year's party, the koto sets the mood better, don't you think? I hope everyone enjoys it.

text.ja: あぅっ、ふ、服がぁ……やっ、だめっ……んぅっ、見ないでぇ……だめ、です……ひゃぁんっ！　おっぱい、触っちゃ……だ、めぇ……
text.en: Ah, no, my clothes... Don't look, please... No, no, no... My breasts, don't touch... No, stop...

text.ja: 下着はつけてないのかって……和服って、そういうものでしょう？　ち、違います、触りやすいようにだなんて……誤解ですよぉっ……
text.en: You think I'm not wearing underwear because it's a kimono? That's not true... it's just that kimonos are designed to be easy to remove, that's all... Don't get the wrong idea.

text.ja: んぅっ、んふぅぅぅ……宴会中、なのにぃ……あっ、んっ……こんなとこで、なんてぇ……やっ……誰かに、見られちゃいますよぉ……
text.en: Nn, nnfuuu... In the middle of a party, no less... Ah, nn... What am I doing... Someone might see us...
